channel.title: Tool Use Cases: Daily builder log
channel.description: Updated on weekdays. Only verified breaking changes, deadlines and price changes. Published by Lali Publications.

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 23, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: OpenCode: v2.4.0 (Nov 23, 2026): the GitHub Copilot provider no longer reads GITHUB_TOKEN, plugins pinned to @latest or a version range now update themselves every 24 hours, and MCP servers are probed on the newest protocol first. Test for this: If CI uses Copilot through OpenCode, set COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN instead of GITHUB_TOKEN. Pin plugins to an exact version if you don't want silent updates, and set protocol: "legacy" on any MCP server that stops connecting. On macOS 12, go straight to v2.4.1, which fixes messages failing to save. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Breaking change: Cline: v4.1.27 (Nov 20, 2026): with no saved model, the Cline provider now starts on the first free model instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, default models change for 67 other providers, and read_files results are no longer cut to 8k characters. Test for this: Open the model picker in every workspace that never saved a model and pick the one you expect. Full-size file reads send more tokens per task, so watch cost on large files. Source: https://github.com/cline/cline/releases/tag/v4.1.27 (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: v2.1.330 (Nov 20, 2026) adds sign-in to Enterprise Admin Console organizations, which then apply org settings and their cloud provider or gateway, and fixes ExitWorktree deleting a worktree another running session was using. Test for this: On an Enterprise org, run claude auth login again and confirm which provider and settings now apply. If you run parallel sessions in worktrees, upgrade before using the worktree exit dialog. This release also restores the automatic retry when max_tokens exceeds a model's limit, which 2.1.329 had removed. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.330 (checked 10:25 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 20, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Gemini CLI: v0.70.0 (Nov 19, 2026) skips system-level MCP servers whose local command, script or parent folder is writable by non-admin users, with a startup security warning, and extension link prompts now default to No. Test for this: If you ship MCP servers through /etc/gemini-cli/settings.json or system-defaults.json, make the command and its folder root-owned and not group- or world-writable, then confirm the server still loads. Scripts that run gemini extensions link without a TTY now need --consent. Source: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30283 (checked 10:23 AM PT) | Breaking change: Codex: CLI 0.171.0 (Nov 19, 2026) adds GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to the model catalog with Sol as the default catalog selection, and turns the TUI workspace (document, image and subagent previews) on by default. Test for this: If you rely on the catalog default, pin your model in config.toml so runs and costs don't change under you. Check that the new TUI layout still works in narrow terminals and over SSH. Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.171.0 (checked 10:23 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: v2.1.329 (Nov 19, 2026) shows where a folder's hooks are declared in the trust dialog, warns when managed-settings hooks fail to load, and fixes ~/.claude.json being reset to defaults after a network stall or file lock. Test for this: Re-open trusted repos and read the hooks location before accepting. If your org pushes hooks through managed settings, look for the new load-failure warning. /code-review <pr number> now reads the PR with gh pr diff, so make sure gh is installed and signed in. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329 (checked 10:23 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 19, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: OpenCode: v2.3.1 (Nov 17, 2026): shell commands still running at their timeout now move to the background instead of being killed, timeout: 0 now means the 120-second default, and background compaction is on by default. Test for this: If a script used timeout: 0 to wait forever, set an explicit timeout. Background compaction can spend tokens on a summary you never use; set compaction.background: false to turn it off. v2.3.2 also stops GPT-6.2 models re-billing the system prompt every step. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.3.1 (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: v2.1.328 (Nov 18, 2026) adds auto mode for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and the Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode set now start in it. Test for this: On a cloud provider, set a permission mode in settings if you want prompts as before. mcp_tool hooks can now use "onFailure": "block", so a failing hook stops the action instead of letting it through. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328 (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Breaking change: VS Code: 1.147 (Nov 18, 2026) deprecates VS Code desktop on macOS Ventura and Sonoma and on 32-bit ARM Linux, and removes the experimental AI usage stats in the Status Bar (editor.aiStats.enabled). Test for this: If your team or CI runs VS Code on macOS 13 or 14 or on 32-bit ARM Linux (for example 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS), plan an OS upgrade now. Remove editor.aiStats.enabled from shared settings. The Local harness is still set for removal in February 2027. Source: https://code.visualstudio.com/updates/v1_147 (checked 10:25 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 18, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: MCP reference servers: Release v2.5.0 (Nov 18, 2026) fixes 8 security vulnerabilities in the Git, Filesystem and Everything servers. The Git server now turns off Git's auto maintenance and lazy fetching, and sets diff.submodule to short, for every Git command it runs. Test for this: Upgrade mcp-server-git to 2026.11.18, server-filesystem to 2.4.0 and server-everything to 2.3.1. If you are on a date-versioned server-filesystem (2025.x or 2026.x), npm won't offer 2.4.0 as an upgrade: install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.4.0 explicitly. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.5.0 (checked 10:16 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenAI Agents SDK: Python SDK v0.25.0 (Nov 17, 2026) removes the Runloop sandbox provider. Test for this: Search your code for Runloop before upgrading. If your agents run in a Runloop sandbox, pin openai-agents below 0.25.0 until you move them to another sandbox provider. Source: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/releases/tag/v0.25.0 (checked 10:16 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: v2.1.327 (Nov 17, 2026): nested commands that don't get the session's token no longer inherit CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES, and WebFetch now refuses URLs over 2,000 characters before any permission prompt. Test for this: If scripts or nested claude calls relied on the inherited OAuth scopes, set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES on those commands yourself. Check any workflow that fetches very long URLs (signed links, long query strings). Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.327 (checked 10:16 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 17, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: GitHub Copilot: As of Nov 16, 2026, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra are deprecated across most Copilot experiences, including Chat, inline edits, agent mode and code completions (Opus 4.8 stays for individual annual-plan subscribers). Test for this: Search custom agents, CLI scripts and SDK code for those model names and switch to the suggested alternatives: Claude Opus 5.5 for both Opus models, GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna for GPT-5.6 Terra. Admins who turned off default model enablement must enable the alternatives. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-16-github-copilot-models-deprecated-on-november-16-2026 (checked 10:24 AM PT) | Breaking change: Visual Studio Code: VS Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness for Copilot agent sessions; GitHub said on Nov 16, 2026 it will be removed in February 2027. The Copilot harness, the default for new sessions since VS Code 1.143, replaces it. Test for this: Start a new session and pick Copilot under Session Target, then check your customizations still work: switching harnesses doesn't convert every customization. Admins: test permission controls and sandbox settings with the Copilot harness; the vscode.temporaryDefaultToLocalHarness exception goes away too. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-16-vs-code-retires-the-local-harness-in-february-2027 (checked 10:24 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: v2.1.326 (Nov 16, 2026) stops sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux and WSL from writing to some sensitive home folders by default, and sessions with no mode set start in auto mode, not Manual, when your organization's policy hasn't loaded. Test for this: Re-run any sandboxed task that writes under your home folder; if it now fails, allow the folder with sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite in user or managed settings. If you have hooks that print "decision": "block", check they don't now block calls they used to let through. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326 (checked 10:22 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: Desktop v1.19.6 (Nov 17, 2026) offers OpenCode 1 users the upgrade to OpenCode 2.0, which installs only when you choose Restart to upgrade, Upgrade on quit or Later. Sessions, projects and settings are kept, but plugins made for OpenCode 1 need an update. Test for this: Before you accept the upgrade, list the plugins you use and check each one has an OpenCode 2 version. Pick Later if one doesn't. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.19.6 (checked 10:23 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 16, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Claude Code: In v2.1.325 (Nov 13, 2026), sandboxed Bash commands follow the normal permission flow by default instead of running without prompts, and scheduled tasks and /loop ask before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks. Test for this: If you rely on sandboxed commands or scheduled tasks running unattended, run one after upgrading and watch for new prompts. To keep the old sandbox behavior, set sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true; to let a scheduled task run a skill, add Skill(name) to permissions.allow. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325 (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Deadline: GitHub Copilot: GitHub said on Nov 13, 2026 that Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 leave all Copilot experiences on Dec 14, 2026 (Haiku 4.5 stays for individual annual-plan subscribers). Test for this: Search Copilot settings, custom agents, CLI scripts and SDK code for those model names and switch before Dec 14 to the suggested replacements: Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon or Grok 4.7. Admins who turned off default model enablement must enable the replacements. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-13-upcoming-deprecation-of-selected-github-copilot-models-in-december (checked 10:25 AM PT) | Breaking change: GitHub Copilot CLI: In 1.0.112 (Nov 13, 2026), the CLI uses each model's recommended context window by default, keeping any context size you chose explicitly. copilot -p "/compact" --silent no longer prints the compaction result line to stdout. Test for this: If you budget AI credits per session, check /context after upgrading to see the new window size. If a script parses the output of copilot -p "/compact" --silent, run it and confirm it no longer expects the compaction line. Source: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.112 (checked 10:25 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 13, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Codex: In rust-v0.169.0 (Nov 13, 2026), codex exec keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with --sandbox workspace-write. Test for this: If CI runs codex exec in a fresh checkout and relies on project config or MCP servers, run it after upgrading and check they load. The release notes say to use --trust with codex exec or codex review to explicitly save project trust. Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.169.0 (checked 10:18 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: In v2.3.0 (Nov 13, 2026), subagents run in the background by default: they return immediately and report back when idle. Transcript verbosity also now defaults to low. Test for this: If a workflow expects a subagent's result before the next step, run it after upgrading and check the order still holds. To see every tool step again, set session.verbosity to medium or high; an existing setting is kept. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.3.0 (checked 10:18 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: In v2.1.323 (Nov 12, 2026), plugin.json accepts engines["claude-code"]: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded. Test for this: If you publish a plugin, set an engines["claude-code"] range you have tested and run claude plugin validate; if you install plugins, check after upgrading that the ones you rely on still load. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323 (checked 10:18 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 12, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Codex: In rust-v0.167.2 (Nov 11, 2026), Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. Test for this: If you run Codex on Vertex AI, run a tool-heavy task after upgrading and check tool calls still complete. The release notes give the opt-out: set incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false under [features] in config.toml. Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.167.2 (checked 10:20 AM PT) | Breaking change: LangGraph CLI: In langgraph-cli 0.4.43 (Nov 12, 2026), the discontinued local debugger image is removed: langgraph up --debugger-port now returns "No such option". New --studio-url and --api-url flags point to hosted Studio. Test for this: Search your scripts, Makefiles and CI for --debugger-port and remove it before upgrading; use the printed Studio link, or --studio-url and --api-url, instead. Source: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/pull/8543 (checked 10:22 AM PT) | Breaking change: CrewAI: In crewAI 1.15.40 (Nov 11, 2026), openai, azure and openrouter embedders use a native OpenAI function: no CHROMA_OPENAI_API_KEY fallback, and empty input raises ValueError instead of returning []. Test for this: If your embedder key lives only in CHROMA_OPENAI_API_KEY, move it to api_key, EMBEDDINGS_OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY, then run Knowledge or RAG with an empty document to see how your code handles the new ValueError. Source: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8934 (checked 10:23 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 11, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: MCP servers (server-filesystem): v2.4.0 (Nov 11, 2026) fixes two vulnerabilities in @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem 2.3.0. Package managers rank 2.3.0 below every 2025.x and 2026.x date version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. Test for this: If you run a date version of server-filesystem, install it explicitly: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0, then confirm the version your MCP client launches. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT) | Breaking change: MCP servers (mcp-server-git): mcp-server-git 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) stops a repository's own Git config from making the server run a program, and refuses a Git older than 2.31. Test for this: Run git --version on every machine or image that runs mcp-server-git; upgrade Git to 2.31 or newer before moving to 2026.11.11. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT) | Breaking change: MCP servers (mcp-server-fetch): mcp-server-fetch 2026.11.11 (in v2.4.0) now refuses IPv6 site-local fec0::/10 and other IPv6 addresses outside 2000::/3 without an IPv4 address, and matches robots.txt against the resolved path. Test for this: After upgrading, re-run any fetch calls that hit internal IPv6 hosts or paths like //private; expect them to be refused now. Source: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (checked 10:17 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 10, 2026
item.description: Price change: Claude Code: In 2.1.321 (Nov 9, 2026), Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) is added and is now the default Fable model: 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads. Test for this: If you pick Fable without pinning a version, run /model or check your usage after updating to confirm which model you're on, and re-check your per-task cost against the new rates. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321 (checked 10:21 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), ImageResponse.image is removed from @opencode/ai; read response.images[0] instead. Test for this: If your code imports @opencode/ai, search it for .image on image responses and switch to response.images[0] before upgrading. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.2.7 (checked 10:21 AM PT) | Breaking change: OpenCode: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), on a Location still loading plugins, SDK agent.list returns the agents loaded so far, and integration.list, usage.limits, vcs.init, rpc.call and artifact.* no longer wait up to 5 seconds. Test for this: If your SDK client lists agents or integrations right after startup, check that plugin-provided entries still show up; refresh on the matching *.updated event. Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v2.2.7 (checked 10:21 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 9, 2026
item.description: Breaking change: Claude Code: In 2.1.319 (Nov 6, 2026), auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways, asks about or denies calls the server can't check, with no fallback to the built-in classifier. Test for this: If you run Claude Code in auto mode behind a gateway or with telemetry off, run an unattended task and watch for new prompts or denials. Set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 to keep the built-in classifier (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged). Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319 (checked 10:08 AM PT) | Breaking change: Claude Code: In 2.1.319 (Nov 6, 2026), self-paced /loop ends when a turn finishes without rescheduling, instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup. Test for this: If you rely on self-paced /loop to keep checking on its own, confirm it still runs after a turn that doesn't reschedule. Set CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 to keep the old behavior. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319 (checked 10:08 AM PT) | Breaking change: GitHub Copilot CLI: In 1.0.108 (Nov 9, 2026), creating or resuming an SDK session, or replacing its tools, with two custom tools of the same name is now an error. Test for this: If you build on the Copilot SDK, check that every custom tool you register has a unique name, then create and resume a session to confirm it starts. Source: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.108 (checked 10:09 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 3, 2026
item.description: Deadline: GitHub Actions: Starting Dec 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories unless an Actions event policy allows them. Brownouts run Nov 9 and Nov 16, 16:00-18:00 UTC. Test for this: Before Nov 9, use Insights to find workflow runs the rule would block, including AI agent or PR-review bots on pull_request_target. Allow the ones you need in an Actions event policy, or move them off that trigger. Source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-02-pull_request_target-blocked-by-default-december-2/ (checked 10:10 AM PT) | Price change: Gemini API: gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-pro automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash and are billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates, with breaking API changes. Test for this: Search your code for gemini-2.5-pro, switch it to gemini-3.8-flash before Dec 1, and test function calling, thought_signature handling, thinking_level (replaces thinking_budget) and any sampling parameters or prefilled model turns. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog (checked 10:10 AM PT) | Price change: Gemini API: gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated. Effective Dec 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-flash automatically route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and are billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates, with breaking API changes. Test for this: Search your code for gemini-2.5-flash, switch it to gemini-3.5-flash-lite before Dec 1, and rerun your evals: the same breaking changes apply (thought_signature validation, thinking_level, removed sampling parameters and prefill). Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog (checked 10:10 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 2, 2026
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Nine days left to keep working in Jules: sessions can continue until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules turns read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Install Jules Tools (npm install -g @google/jules), run jules login, and export your settings, memories and sessions now; move open tasks to another coding agent before Nov 11. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: Since Nov 1, 2026, Link bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions. Plans and token allowances are unchanged, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for added tax. If you pay in a local currency instead of USD, expect the charge to move with the exchange rate. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them. Existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app. If you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 was deprecated on Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026. After that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Search your scripts, settings and API calls for fast mode on Opus 4.8 (speed: "fast" with claude-opus-4-8) and switch them to Opus 5.5 before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 10:01 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Oct 31, 2026 (format preview)
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Google is winding Jules down: you can keep working in sessions until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules is read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Before Nov 11, export any sessions you need with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules) and move open tasks to another coding agent. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them; existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app; if you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: From Nov 1, 2026, Link bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions: plans and token allowances stay the same, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for tax; if checkout offers your local currency, note the charge can vary month to month with the exchange rate, and USD stays available for a fixed price. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:09 PM PT) | Deadline: Lovable: Lovable's docs say the current chat pricing (per-message price and daily chat allowance) is a temporary offering that applies through Oct 31, 2026; the page does not say what applies after. Test for this: Recheck the Lovable chat docs and your plan's chat allowance on Nov 2 before budgeting chat-heavy work. Source: https://docs.lovable.dev/features/chats (checked 08:07 PM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Find scripts and settings that use fast mode with Opus 4.8 and switch them to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 08:07 PM PT)
